question: A mathematics group compares the scalar and vector products of $\vec{a}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$. The scalar product is used to calculate the angle between the vectors, while the magnitude of the vector product represents the area of the parallelogram formed by them. The students finally compare both products with the magnitudes of the original vectors.(a) Calculate the magnitudes of $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$.(b) Evaluate $\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}$ and determine the angle between them.(c) Evaluate $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$ and find the area of the corresponding parallelogram.(d) Verify that $|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}|^2+(\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b})^2=|\vec{a}|^2|\vec{b}|^2$.
explanation: (a)`|\vec{a}|=\sqrt{1^2+2^2+2^2}=3`Similarly,`|\vec{b}|=\sqrt{2^2+(-1)^2+2^2}=3`(b)`\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}=(1)(2)+(2)(-1)+(2)(2)=4`If $\theta$ is the angle between the vectors, then`\cos\theta=\frac{\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|}=\frac{4}{9}`Therefore,`\theta=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{4}{9}\right)`(c)\\vec{a}\\times\\vec{b}=\\begin{vmatrix}\\hat{i} & \\hat{j} & \\hat{k}\\\\1 & 2 & 2\\\\2 & -1 & 2\\end{vmatrix}`\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=6\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-5\hat{k}`Therefore,`|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}|=\sqrt{6^2+2^2+(-5)^2}=\sqrt{65}`Hence, the area of the parallelogram is $\sqrt{65}$ square units.(d)The left-hand side is`|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}|^2+(\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b})^2=65+16=81`The right-hand side is`|\vec{a}|^2|\vec{b}|^2=(3^2)(3^2)=81`Hence, the required relation is verified.

options.A:
(a) $|\vec{a}|=|\vec{b}|=3$
(b) $\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}=2$, $\theta=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{9}\right)$
(c) $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=6\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-5\hat{k}$, area $=\sqrt{65}$
(d) The two sides of the identity are $69$ and $81$
